raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The direct external linker (`--enable-unified-cache-external-linker`) accepts FULL + MAMBA models only when the full-attention pool is plain MLA (#44977, Kimi-K3). It also rejects any model whose Mamba pool carries registered slot states. Two families with cookbook linker options therefore fail at startup with `ValueError: The direct external linker supports FULL + MAMBA models only with a plain MLA pool ...`:

- Qwen3.5 (MHA + GDN). The AgentX tables on `Qwen3.5.mdx` offer the Mooncake linker as a KV offload option.
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next / Qwen4-Exp (`Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx`). Its full-attention layers are QSA: an MHA KV pool plus a paged compressed-K indexer cache. Its Mamba slots also carry the PLE short-conv windows and the N-gram history.

## Modifications

- `_build_mamba_device_pool_group` accepts an MHA full-attention pool, and a `QSATokenToKVPool` (MHA KV plus compressed indexer). An MHA KV entry stores each layer's K and V in one per-page object, the same layout as the Mamba + SWA group.
- QSA compressed indexer: a new `INDEXER` entry derived from the KV transfer. A full page holds whole compression groups (QSA requires `page_size % ratio == 0`), so full page `p` maps to compressed rows `[p * page_size / ratio, (p + 1) * page_size / ratio)`. The per-request pending ring is not transferred, because a linker hit always ends on a page boundary, where the pending group is empty.
- Mamba slot states: a new `MAMBA_SLOT_STATE` entry derived from the Mamba transfer. It packs the short-conv state of each PLE layer and the N-gram history row of the same slot. Each short-conv state loads on its own layer. The N-gram history is read before the first layer, so it loads with the first Mamba layer, which is the layer `get_ngram_context` already waits for. The Mamba + SWA group gains the same entry.
- Still rejected: int8 Mamba checkpoints, unified memory, DCP > 1, and packed MTP draft KV. The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AgentX cell that runs MTP 3-1-4 therefore still needs packed-draft support, which is a follow-up.

## Accuracy Tests

The oracle follows `test_unified_cache_linker_kimi_linear.py`. Four LongBench prompts are cut to `PREFIX + 1` tokens and warmed, then extended with a 63-token random suffix. The 32 greedy output ids and logprobs from a device hit must equal those from a linker hit after `/flush_cache` (`cached_tokens_details.host == PREFIX`). Setup: 1x B300, TP1, Mooncake over TCP, `--page-size 64 --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer --mamba-track-interval 128 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`.

| Model | Setting | Tree | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.5-2B | prefix 1024, deterministic | main | startup `ValueError` (plain MLA only) |
| Qwen3.5-2B | prefix 1024, deterministic | this PR | 4/4 ids equal, max abs logprob diff 0.0 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 1024, flashinfer GDN | main | startup `ValueError` |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 1024, flashinfer GDN | this PR | 4/4 equal, diff 0.0 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 1024, flashinfer GDN | this PR, slot states not transferred (control) | 0/4 equal, diff up to 5.5 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 4096, deterministic | this PR | 4/4 equal, diff 0.0 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 4096, deterministic | this PR, QSA indexer not transferred (control) | 0/4 equal, diff 1.8-2.8 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | prefix 4096, deterministic | this PR, slot states not transferred (control) | 0/4 equal, diff 1.5-3.4 |

- The 4096 prefix exceeds the model's 2048-token indexer budget, so QSA top-k selection reads the restored compressed keys. At 1024 every token is selected and the indexer has no effect.
- Above the budget, the default kernels are not run-to-run deterministic: two device hits agree on only 1/4 at 4096. Those runs therefore use `--enable-deterministic-inference --attention-backend triton --linear-attn-{prefill,decode}-backend triton`, under which two device hits agree 4/4 with diff 0.0.
- The controls drop the named entry in a local build only.

## Tests

- `test_linker_pool_assembler.py`:
  - slot states load on their reader layers, with the N-gram history on the first Mamba layer;
  - no slot-state entry is built without side states;
  - a QSA full page maps to its compressed page;
  - an MHA full pool maps K and V of a layer to one transfer layer;
  - a DSA full pool is still rejected.
- 17 passed on CPU.

@@ -531,6 +526,45 @@ def _mamba_device_pool_entry(
     )
 
 
+def _mamba_slot_state_entry(
+    req_to_token_pool: Any, start_layer: int
+) -> DevicePoolEntry | None:
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.ple_state_pool import PLE_NGRAM_STATE_LAYER_ID
+
+    buffers, layer_mapping = [], {}
+    states = (req_to_token_pool.short_conv_pool, req_to_token_pool.ngram_pool)
+    for state in (state for state in states if state.enabled):
+        for _, buffer, _, layer_id in state.iter_transfer_state_entries():
+            # Request-wide history is read before the first layer; it rides the
+            # first Mamba layer, the layer its reader waits for.
+            if layer_id == PLE_NGRAM_STATE_LAYER_ID:
+                layer_id = min(req_to_token_pool.mamba_map)
+            layer = layer_id - start_layer
+            layer_mapping[layer] = (*layer_mapping.get(layer, ()), len(buffers))
+            buffers.append(buffer)
+    if not buffers:
+        return None
+    return DevicePoolEntry(
+        name=PoolName.MAMBA_SLOT_STATE,
+        indices_from_pool=PoolName.MAMBA,
+        device_pool=req_to_token_pool.mamba_pool,
+        components=[buffers],
+        layer_mapping=layer_mapping,
+        page_size=1,
+        rows_are_pages=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _mamba_device_pool_entries(
+    req_to_token_pool: Any, start_layer: int
+) -> list[DevicePoolEntry]:
+    entries = [_mamba_device_pool_entry(req_to_token_pool, start_layer)]
+    slot_state = _mamba_slot_state_entry(req_to_token_pool, start_layer)
+    if slot_state is not None:
+        entries.append(slot_state)
+    return entries
+
+
 def _build_mamba_swa_device_pool_group(
     kvcache: Any, params: Any, page_size: int
 ) -> DevicePoolGroup:
@@ -546,12 +580,32 @@ def _build_mamba_swa_device_pool_group(
         _mha_device_pool_entry(
             PoolName.SWA, kvcache.swa_kv_pool, swa_mapping, page_size
         ),
-        _mamba_device_pool_entry(params.req_to_token_pool, kvcache.start_layer),
+        *_mamba_device_pool_entries(params.req_to_token_pool, kvcache.start_layer),
     ]
     num_layers = max(layer for entry in entries for layer in entry.layer_mapping)
     return DevicePoolGroup(entries, num_layers + 1, page_size)
 
 
+def _qsa_indexer_entry(kvcache: Any, full_mapping: dict[int, int]) -> DevicePoolEntry:
+    ratio = kvcache.qsa_compress_ratio
+
+    def compressed_indices(indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # A full page holds whole compression groups, so it maps to one
+        # compressed page; its pending ring is empty at every page boundary.
+        return indices.reshape(-1, ratio)[:, 0].div(ratio, rounding_mode="floor")
+
+    return DevicePoolEntry(
+        name=PoolName.INDEXER,
+        indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV,
+        device_pool=kvcache,
+        components=[kvcache.qsa_compressed_k_buffer_pool],
+        layer_mapping=full_mapping,
+        page_size=kvcache.qsa_compressed_page_size,
+        rows_are_pages=False,
+        index_mapper=compressed_indices,
+    )
+
+
 def _build_mamba_device_pool_group(
     kvcache: Any, params: Any, page_size: int
 ) -> DevicePoolGroup:
@@ -560,36 +614,47 @@ def _build_mamba_device_pool_group(

+            "plain MLA or MHA pool, without DCP or packed draft KV."
         )
 
-    entries = [

-        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain MLA"):

+        mha.k_scale_buffer = mha.native_k_scale_buffer = None

+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain MLA or MHA"):
             resolve()
 
     def test_unsupported_strategy_fails_with_context(self):
@@ -824,5 +837,71 @@ def test_unsupported_strategy_fails_with_context(self):
             )
 
 
+class TestMambaSlotStateEntry(CustomTestCase):
+    def _req_to_token_pool(self, *, side_states: bool):
+        short_conv = ShortConvPool(
+            size=4,
+            state_shape=(2, 3),
+            layer_ids=[3, 7] if side_states else [],
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device="cpu",
+        )
+        ngram = NGramPool(
+            size=4, context_len=2 if side_states else 0, eos_token_id=0, device="cpu"
+        )
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            short_conv_pool=short_conv,
+            ngram_pool=ngram,
+            mamba_map={1: 0, 5: 1},
+            mamba_pool=object(),
+        )
+
+    def test_side_states_follow_mamba_slots_on_their_reader_layers(self):
+        pool = self._req_to_token_pool(side_states=True)
+        entry = _mamba_slot_state_entry(pool, start_layer=0)
+
+        self.assertEqual(entry.name, PoolName.MAMBA_SLOT_STATE)
+        self.assertEqual(entry.indices_from_pool, PoolName.MAMBA)
+        # Short-conv states load with their own layer; the N-gram history, read
+        # before the first layer, with the first Mamba layer.
+        self.assertEqual(entry.layer_mapping, {3: (0,), 7: (1,), 1: (2,)})
+
+        slot = 2
+        conv0 = pool.short_conv_pool.conv_state[0]
+        ngram = pool.ngram_pool.context
+        ptrs, sizes, offsets = entry.get_prepared_layer_range_meta([slot], 3)
+        self.assertEqual(ptrs, [[conv0[slot].data_ptr()]])
+        self.assertEqual(sizes, [[conv0[slot].nbytes]])
+        self.assertEqual(offsets, [[0]])
+        ptrs, sizes, offsets = entry.get_prepared_layer_range_meta([slot], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(ptrs, [[ngram[slot].data_ptr()]])
+        self.assertEqual(offsets, [[2 * conv0[slot].nbytes]])
+
+    def test_no_entry_without_side_states(self):
+        pool = self._req_to_token_pool(side_states=False)
+        self.assertIsNone(_mamba_slot_state_entry(pool, start_layer=0))
+
+
+class TestQSAIndexerEntry(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_full_page_maps_to_its_compressed_page(self):
+        # 64-token full pages, ratio 4: page p owns compressed rows [16p, 16p + 16).
+        buffers = [torch.zeros((80, 1, 8), dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(2)]
+        kvcache = SimpleNamespace(
+            qsa_compress_ratio=4,
+            qsa_compressed_page_size=16,
+            qsa_compressed_k_buffer_pool=buffers,
+        )
+        entry = _qsa_indexer_entry(kvcache, {1: 0, 3: 1})
+
+        self.assertEqual(entry.indices_from_pool, PoolName.KV)
+        full_page_2 = torch.arange(128, 192)
+        compressed = entry.translate_indices(full_page_2)
+        self.assertEqual(compressed.tolist(), list(range(32, 48)))
+        self.assertEqual(entry.prepare_locations(compressed), [32])
+        ptrs, sizes, _ = entry.get_prepared_layer_range_meta([32], 3)
+        self.assertEqual(ptrs, [[buffers[1][32].data_ptr()]])
+        self.assertEqual(sizes, [[16 * buffers[1][32].nbytes]])
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
